scope_fields.source_map: Ohtsuki Conjecture 3.22, map (30); map (29) at A(t)=1
accepted_claims: Ohtsuki Conjecture 3.22 is false: Patureau-Mirand, Theorem 4 (2012), gives a nonzero kernel element for the exact Laurent-polynomial hair map (30).
The same exact Laurent case is map (29) at the admissible choice A(t)=1. No nontrivial localization is needed to refute the stated conjecture.

The published finite connected witness has first Betti number 17 and Ohtsuki loop-degree 16. Its nonzero source class is separated by cohomological content; all hair-image coefficients vanish by the same local gluing argument.
